intake.description: A pipe under the bathroom basin burst and water spread into the bedroom, causing damage to the flooring and bedroom wall. The estimated cost for repairs is Rs 65,000.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999.

route.reason: policy number PRP-26-12907 has prefix for property; intake agent read the email as property

citations.quote: We pay for damage to the home and contents caused by water escaping suddenly from a fixed water tank, pipe or appliance, subject to PROP-EXC-4.1 and PROP-EXC-4.2.
The policyholder pays the first Rs 10,000 of each claim under PROP-COV-2.2.
We do not pay for damage that happens gradually, including wear and tear, rot, damp, mould and water seeping slowly over weeks or months.
We do not pay for escape of water damage that happens while the home is unoccupied

coverage.reasoning: The claim involves a pipe under the bathroom basin bursting suddenly and causing water damage to the flooring and wall, which fits the coverage for sudden escape of water under clause PROP-COV-2.2. The incident did not occur while the home was unoccupied and was not gradual, meaning exclusions PROP-EXC-4.1 and PROP-EXC-4.2 do not apply. Therefore, the claim is covered, subject to the policyholder paying the first Rs 10,000 excess as per PROP-LIM-3.3.

reasons: all citations verified against the clause text; outputs passed validation first time
